title: Design, synthesis and network pharmacology-integrated evaluation of benzenesulfonamides as potential Dickkopf-1 (Dkk-1)-targeting anticancer candidates.
authors: Ejaz, Syeda Abida; Bilal, Muhammad Sajjad; Channar, Pervaiz Ali; Ujan, Rabail; Naseem, Sadia; Saeed, Aamer; Channar, Sajid Ali; Sahito, Reshma; Abbas, Qamar
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成苯磺酰胺类抗癌候选物，虽含分子对接和DNA结合实验，但核心是药物小分子对蛋白靶标（Dkk1等）的抑制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Sulfanilamide-based drugs are known to exhibit immense anti-cancer activities, and thus, we sought to design and formulate sulfanilamide derivatives in order to study their potential against carbonic anhydrase II, pancreatic elastase, Dickkopf-1 (Dkk1) and LRP6 proteins, which are potential anti-cancer targets for various cancers. Out of all the synthesized derivatives, compound 4d exhibited significant inhibitory potential against CA-II, with an IC(50) value of 0.348 +/- 0.024 microM, which is about 3-fold higher than that of the reference drug acetazolamide (IC(50) = 0.9979 +/- 0.0024 microM). The significance of Dkk1 was taken into consideration in this study. Molecular docking interaction studies revealed that compound 4d exhibited good binding potential with CA-II, pancreatic elastase, LRP6 and Dkk1, with binding energies of -8.1, -8.7, -7.9 and -10.4 kcal mol(-1), respectively. Furthermore, in the course of DNA binding experiments, compound 4d exhibited the highest binding constant value of 2.3 x 10(7) mol(-1), validating the other biological tests, and these results are in agreement with the reported values, demonstrating the significance of compound 4d to act as a representative drug in the future. Finally, the present work has the potential to pave way for new therapeutic approaches in cancer treatment with the involvement of the less explored Dkk1 signaling target. In addition, a network pharmacology analysis of compound 4d against pancreatic cancer identified 243 shared targets that converged, through protein-protein interactions and enrichment analyses, on the PI3K-AKT and receptor tyrosine kinase signalling axes, providing a system-level rationale for its anticancer potential.
abstract_zh: 基于磺胺类药物已知具有显著的抗癌活性，因此我们旨在设计并合成磺胺衍生物，以研究其对碳酸酐酶II、胰弹性蛋白酶、Dickkopf-1 (Dkk1) 和 LRP6 蛋白的潜在抑制作用，这些蛋白是多种癌症的潜在抗癌靶点。在所有合成的衍生物中，化合物4d对CA-II表现出显著的抑制潜力，其IC(50)值为0.348 ± 0.024微摩尔，约为参考药物乙酰唑胺（IC(50) = 0.9979 ± 0.0024微摩尔）的3倍。本研究特别考虑了Dkk1的重要性。分子对接相互作用研究表明，化合物4d与CA-II、胰弹性蛋白酶、LRP6和Dkk1具有良好的结合潜力，结合能分别为-8.1、-8.7、-7.9和-10.4千卡每摩尔。此外，在DNA结合实验中，化合物4d表现出最高的结合常数值为2.3 x 10(7)摩尔(-1)，验证了其他生物学测试结果，这些结果与已报道值一致，证明了化合物4d未来作为代表性药物的意义。最后，本研究有望为癌症治疗开辟新的治疗途径，涉及较少探索的Dkk1信号靶点。此外，针对胰腺癌的化合物4d网络药理学分析识别出243个共享靶点，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和富集分析，这些靶点汇聚于PI3K-AKT和受体酪氨酸激酶信号轴，为其抗癌潜力提供了系统层面的合理性解释。
